details: The name of the food shall be the name prescribed in the relevant regulations or standard. If no name is prescribed, the name shall be a common or generic name or an appropriate descriptive name.
A complete list of ingredients in descending order of their composition by weight or volume at the time of manufacture. Ingredients less than 5% may be listed in any order after other ingredients.
exemption: Single ingredient foods, fresh fruits and vegetables

applies_to: All packaged foods with surface area > 100 cm²
details: Must declare: Energy, Protein, Carbohydrate (of which sugars), Fat (of which saturated fat and trans fat), and Sodium per 100g/100ml and per serve.
exemption: Small packages (<100 cm²), certain categories like spices, salt, tea, coffee

details: If the product contains any of the following allergens, they must be declared: Cereals containing gluten, Crustaceans, Eggs, Fish, Peanuts, Soybeans, Milk, Tree nuts, Sulphite (≥10 mg/kg).

requirement: Name and Complete Address of Manufacturer
details: Complete name and address of the manufacturer, packer, or bottler including street name, city, state, and country.
Net quantity in terms of weight, volume, or number. Must be in metric units (g, kg, ml, l).

requirement: Date of Manufacture/Packing and Best Before/Use By Date
details: Both manufacturing/packing date and 'Best Before' or 'Use By' date must be declared. Format should be DD/MM/YYYY or other clear format.
License number or registration number issued by FSSAI. Must include FSSAI logo with license number.
For imported packaged food, country of origin must be declared prominently.
Green filled circle in a square for vegetarian. Brown filled circle in a square for non-vegetarian. Symbol size minimum 3mm diameter.

applies_to: Foods requiring preparation or special storage
details: Instructions for proper use, preparation, or reconstitution if the product requires it.
All food additives must be declared by their functional class followed by specific name or INS number (e.g., Preservative (INS 211)).

requirement: Minimum Font Size on Principal Display Panel
details: Font size depends on principal display panel area. For <40 cm²: 1.0mm, 40-170 cm²: 1.5mm, 170-650 cm²: 2.0mm, >650 cm²: 3.0mm minimum letter height.
All mandatory information must be in sharp contrast to the background, clearly legible, and indelible.
